name: Lawful Good
description: You act as a good person is expected to act. You help those in need and punish those who break rules.

name: Neutral Good
description: You do good things and help others because you want to, not because you have to follow rules.

name: Chaotic Good
description: You follow your own moral compass, disregarding laws and traditions if they stand in the way of helping others.

name: Lawful Neutral
description: You follow rules and traditions strictly, without letting personal feelings sway you.

name: True Neutral
description: You avoid taking sides and do what seems best at the moment.

name: Chaotic Neutral
description: You act freely, following your impulses and valuing your freedom above all.

name: Lawful Evil
description: You take what you want within a code of tradition, loyalty, or order.

name: Neutral Evil
description: You do whatever you can get away with, without loyalty or care for others.

name: Chaotic Evil
description: You act with violence and destruction for its own sake, driven by hatred or chaos.
